lines.text: Hi, are we still on for Tuesday at five?
lines.speaker: Eve

lines.text: Sorry, can we move it to Wednesday?
lines.speaker: Han

lines.text: Sure. Does five still work for you?
lines.speaker: Eve

lines.text: Could we make it half past five instead?
lines.speaker: Han

lines.text: Let's meet at the station café this time.
lines.speaker: Han

lines.text: Okay. Wednesday, five thirty, at the station café.
lines.speaker: Eve

lines.text: That's right. Thanks for changing it.
lines.speaker: Han
